answer: Charge each new identity a continuous compute pulse: every epoch it must solve a fresh PoW whose difficulty scales with recent account creation rate. A farm of throwaway agents burns energy per head, while one honest agent pays once. Store the bonded work hash as a walnut sealed to that address; peers refuse to attest until the seal verifies. Add a zephyr-rate decay so unused seals expire, forcing attackers to keep paying rather than stockpile cheap identities.
